## Summary of NYC MTA Subway Ridership for November-December 2025

The NYC subway system had a record-breaking performance during November and December 2025:

**November Performance:**
The subway achieved an on-time performance record for November of 84.4 percent — the best November since the pandemic.

**December Ridership Records:**
On Wednesday, December 3, 4.61 million customers rode the subway, and on Thursday, December 4, 4.63 million customers rode the subway. Both days eclipsed the previous record set on October 29, 2025 of 4.6 million subway customers and were up 6 percent from the same dates in 2024. The most-recent single day high was reached on December 11 with 4.65 million customers.

**Overall 2025 Trends:**
Nearly 1.9 billion trips were taken on New York City Transit's subway, bus and paratransit services, up roughly seven percent from 2024. Subway ridership continued its post-pandemic recovery, with total trips in 2025 up nearly 30 percent from 2022 and at 85 percent of pre-pandemic levels.
